```{r}
pacman::p_load(gt, install = FALSE)
conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

## Overview

This document creates a dementia category table summarizing the distribution of 2,491 participants across six cognitive transition categories for the EWAS manuscript.

## Introduction

Create a dementia category table for the subjects used in the OLS association analysis. This notebook does not collapse the dementia categories. 


```{r}
tic("Read DNAm data")
m <- read_rds(here("data/collaborator_only/covariates_and_meth_DMP_on_chr21.rds")) |>
  # Keep relevant columns
  dplyr::select(subr_id18, a1age, sex, a1smokingstatus, dementia_ages1_eos, starts_with("cg")) |>
  # Exclude subjects with missing smoking status (n=5)
  filter(!is.na(a1smokingstatus))
toc()

glimpse(m[, 1:10])
```


## Dementia Status

```{r}
dm <- 
  m[, 1:10] |> 
  count(dementia_ages1_eos, sort = F) |>
  rename("dementia" = dementia_ages1_eos, "count" = n) |> 
  # Compute percentage
  dplyr::mutate(percentage = count/sum(count)) |> 
  # Convert dementia to character. Otherwise, 
  # in gt table, should specify location like locations = cells_stub("2"), 
  # not locations = cells_stub("MCI")
  mutate(dementia = as.character(dementia)) 
  
dm

```

## Refine dementia category tibble

```{r}
dm_refined <-
  dm |>
  # Add additional columns
  mutate(
    # Add an order column
    order = c(1, 3, 2, 4, 5, 6),
    # dementia_transition = if_else(dementia == "prev", "prevalent dementia", glue("{dementia} transition"))) |>
    # Add baseline and follow-up dementia category
    Baseline = c("normal", "mci", "normal", "normal", "mci", "demented"),
    Followup = c("normal", "mci", "mci", "incid", "incid", "demented"),
    # Add follow-up time (days) - order: stable_normal, stable_mci, normal2mci, normal2incid, mci2incid, prev
    followup_mean = c(3869, 2104, 1921, 2730, 2239, 0),
    followup_sd = c(773, 1020, 139, 905, 720, 0)
  ) |>
  # Reorder the dementia column
  dplyr::arrange(order) |>
  rename(transition = dementia) |>
  relocate(transition, Baseline, Followup, .before = count) |>
  dplyr::select(-order)

dm_refined
```

## Base table

Create the base table

```{r}

dm_base <-
 dm_refined |>
 gt::gt(rowname_col = "transition") |>
 # Format columns before merging
 fmt_number(columns = c(count), decimals = 0, use_seps = TRUE) |>
 fmt_percent(columns = c(percentage), decimals = 1) |>
 fmt_number(columns = c(followup_mean, followup_sd), decimals = 0, use_seps = TRUE) |>
 # Merge columns: count (percentage) and followup_mean (sd)
 cols_merge(
   columns = c(count, percentage),
   pattern = "{1} ({2})"
 ) |>
 cols_merge(
   columns = c(followup_mean, followup_sd),
   pattern = "{1} ({2})"
 ) |>
 # Move follow-up column before count
 cols_move(
   columns = followup_mean,
   after = Followup
 ) |>
 # Label columns
 cols_label(
   count = "N (%)",
   followup_mean = "Followup days"
 ) |>
 ## Add footnotes
 tab_footnote(footnote = md("Mean (SD);"),
              locations = cells_column_labels(columns = followup_mean)) |>
 tab_footnote(footnote = md("Follow-up time to incident dementia, death, or censor date, up to 13.4 years;"),
              locations = cells_column_labels(columns = Followup)) |>
 tab_footnote(footnote = md("Mild Cognitive Impairment;"),
              locations = cells_body(columns = Baseline, rows = 3)) |>
 tab_footnote(footnote = md("Incident dementia;"),
              locations = cells_body(columns = Followup, rows = 4)) |>
 tab_footnote(footnote = md("MCI was assessed at baseline and 5 years later, but no subjects of the two categories progressed to dementia during the whole followup;"),
              locations = cells_stub(c("normal2mci", "stable_mci"))) |>
  tab_footnote(footnote = md("Prevalent dementia;"),
              locations = cells_stub("prev")) |>
 tab_options(footnotes.multiline = FALSE) |>
 ## Add grand summary for count only (merged column)
 grand_summary_rows(
   fns = lst(total = ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
   columns = count,
   fmt = ~ fmt_number(.x, use_seps = TRUE, decimals = 0)
 ) |>
 ## Font style
 tab_style(
   style = list(cell_text(
     size = 6,
     color = "black",
   )),
   locations = lst(
     cells_body(columns = everything()),
     cells_stub_grand_summary(),
   )
 ) |>
 tab_style(
   style = list(cell_text(
     color = "grey20",
     weight = "bold"
   )),
   locations = lst(
     cells_column_labels(),
     cells_stub(),
     cells_stub_grand_summary()
   )
 )


dm_base
```

## Indicate "Normal" as ref. 

The style using "em" as tag have effects only when running from the console, not rendering to html file. But the style using "span" as tag works in both cases. 

```{r}
#| column: screen

dm_full <- 
dm_base |>
  text_transform(
    locations = cells_stub("stable_normal"),
    fn = function(x) {
      # paste("Normal <em style=\"font-size: 10px; color: red;\"> (ref) </em>")
      # "Normal <em style='font-size: 10px; color: darkred;'> (ref) </em>"
      # paste("Normal <span style=\"font-size: 10px; color: red;\"> (ref) </span>")
      "stable_normal <span style='font-size: 10px; color: darkred;'> (ref) </span>"
    }
  )

dm_full
```

## Save the table

```{r}

fs::dir_create(here("demographics/output"))
# Base table
dm_base |>
  write_rds(here("demographics/output/dementia_category_table_base.rds")) |>
  gtsave(file = here("demographics/output/dementia_category_table_base.png"), expand = 10, vwidth = 800, vheight = 1400, zoom = 2)

# Full table
dm_full |>
  write_rds(here("demographics/output/dementia_category_table_full.rds")) |>
  gtsave(file = here("demographics/output/dementia_category_table_full.png"))

```
